Primal theme contact sheet

85 families, each drawn from its own emitted theme file. Cards are sorted by ASCENDING nearest-neighbour distance, so the worst cases are on the first screen - the closest pair in the whole catalogue is Primal Dusk at Downer 1.33. Every card appears twice. The second grid is how a deuteranope sees it, and for this owner that grid is the real one.

Twins - the 20 closest pairs, and what admitted each

A pair whose grounds are within a just-noticeable difference is admitted only when it earns its identity somewhere else: a different syntax register, a different emphasis, or enough distance in the six non-ground slots on its own. That is what the last column reports.
